I used to be satisfied with a sleep sound app that just made some white noise to give me a blank canvas for sleep. That was the olden days of iPhones, a simpler and more innocent time.

I’ve used a different sleep sound app happily for many years. It’s been collecting strikes as iOS moved forward and they haven’t. First it had no support for Shortcuts, but at the time I thought of Shortcuts as fun and new; now it’s gotten to be a part of every day I rely on. Then no AirPlay (can’t play to the HomePod mini on my nightstand), then they collect tracking data....

I finally started looking for an alternative. Turns out the other freemium sleep sound apps lack support for iOS integrations, or collect tracking data, or require a subscription, or don’t have good sounds or sound mixing (or just have nature sounds).

Then I found Dark Noise. Its UI is straightforward and clear; it supports AirPlay, Shortcuts (the best Shortcuts support I’ve seen in any sound app!), collects no data, has no subscription ask... it’s fantastic! And the sound selection has a wide variety of nature and non-nature sounds - look, I’m a city boy; I really don’t have any history of sleeping hearing frogs, and if I can hear the rain that just tells my brain that there’s an unsafe open window or a leak.

Dark Noise isn’t free; it costs five *whole* dollars. That’s about a penny and a half per day (well, night) over the first year.

But look, free isn’t free, and that’s becoming increasingly clear. With Dark Noise, it’s above board and completely transparent: I pay five bucks and I get a really good app. What a novel concept!

title.label: A MUST HAVE FOR POOR SLEEP

content.label:
If you have trouble sleeping for whatever reason, you need to get this app. For me it has been a life changer.  There are very very few apps I can say that about. 

I suffer from sever chronic pain and my ability to sleep is completely compromised by the pain. I always have some type of music playing all night. I had to subscribe to Apple Music to find enough Gregorian Chants, ambient electronic, or soft instrumental music to get enough music to create playlists long enough to get me through the night without a ton of repetitive music. 

For less than the price of 1 month of Apple Music (sorry Tim), you can create the most wonderful and diverse background sounds to help lull you to sleep. 

Not only can I mix the sounds in this app, but I can mix it with my Apple Music playlists. I have my monks chanting at the beach, during a rainstorm, by the fire. Or Nakai playing Native American Flute by a lake and waterfall, with distant thunder. Paul Horn playing flute inside the Great Pyramids, with a cat purring softly, while the wind whips across the desert. Set you dream stage with this app. Create themes for whatever you need to place yourself in the best ‘environment ‘ to sleep, read, study, or just in the background while you do whatever. 

You can create that personal sound you need to help you relax, reduce anxiety, lower blood pressure, or mask pain instead of taking more opiates. Let your imagination run wild while creating the perfect background sounds that work for you. 

This is definitely a 5 star app. I congratulate and thank the developers for creating this tool that helps me actually get some sleep at night. Or anytime using headphones.
A lot of options - the Beach may be my favorite - but so many to choose from!

This app is gorgeous and thoughtfully designed with excellent widgets and Shortcuts integration, and the variety of sounds is impressive (5 stars). However, the quality of the majority of sounds is frankly just average, which is disappointing, considering that sound is the app's entire purpose (3 stars). Most of the sounds are thin and practically monophonic, with only a couple providing any sense of depth and spatiality at all ("Lake" and "Ship Deck," for example, are excellent and convincingly immersive), and volume levels vary wildly across sounds (at 50% volume, "Heavy Rain" is finally audible, while "Cat Purring" is deafening). I hope the developer will make sound quality improvement a priority for future updates. Until then, I'll return to the similar apps in my library that offer superior recordings with exemplary stereo presence.

title.label: Love the app... Possible battery issue

content.label: I’d like to say that this is a very well-designed app. Love the look, feel, and sound options. Last night was the first night I used it all night. I had Space Engine running for about 5 hours on my iPhone 11 Pro Max. Screen was off. Battery went from around 90% to 9% in five hours of running. Is this normal?

[2.0 update below] The app design is lovely, and the sounds are of a fine quality … except there aren’t any stereo sounds as far as I can tell. I’m a sounds app connoisseur (yes, that’s a thing), and of the six sound apps I use, even the free ones, this is the only one I have that has no stereo sounds. (Even the color noise sounds can be produced in stereo.) So the sounds will be fine if you’re far from the source, but if you’re close by they’ll sound a bit flat and less immersive. I’m hoping the “more to come!” promise means this may be addressed in the future.

2.0 update: this version introduces some new sounds, but after auditioning them I’ve found only two that are in stereo: Lake, and Ship Deck. For me, an app centered around monaural ambient sounds is like a camera app that can take only black and white photos. But YMMV.
I love the variety of sounds, and I am thrilled that there is no subsection fee! Kudos!

This app is so good, I am shocked the developer didn’t charge for the upgrade by deploying as a new app. 

Version 3 should deploy as a new app and charge again. It worth paying for...
And it has the best interface by far, too!

title.label: Overall a nice app but its not without issues.

content.label: I’ve been using this app for about 2 months now and although I love the overall design of the app, there are a couple of frustrating issues I’ve been unable to resolve. First, I tried creating a Siri shortcut to start playing Brown Noise on my HomePod but Siri only responds that I need to continue on my iPhone. Second, the app will randomly stop on my HomePod, usually during the middle of the night causing me to wake up. I think its a great app but until these issues are resolved I’ll be looking for something else.

So this might get lost in the reviews but i wanted to review and rate this app ASAP. I've been a beta tester for this app for awhile now but had no reason to rate it until today. My dad has difficulty getting to sleep, and uses a white noise app on his phone. Tried to convince him to switch to Dark Noise a couple months ago but he wouldn't. When asked he said because of all the years he spent in the military, he fell in love with "rain on a tent" and he only found one app that did it. I submitted the feedback to have that sounds added right away. And now, the app has it thanks to the developer. And my dad is now full on using the app. 

Cheers to the dev, I wasn't sure if that sound would get added, yet here we are. 5/5 all around
